Substantial verified progress landed, but the arbitrary-field headline did not close honestly.

The twelve commits from `625eb6c7d9` through `8999773f93` add finite-stage descent for tensor data, finitely presented algebras, Cech/relative Picard classes, etale/PicEt covers, cocycle data, finite affine atlases, and conditional colimit preservation. Everything is rooted through [Pic0CriticalPath.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0CriticalPath.lean:38). `canonicalRankOneAbelIso` remains root-reachable and kernel-clean.

Verification passed:

- Rebuild full build: 9,610 jobs
- Sibling Challenge full build: 8,936 jobs
- LSP before and after edits: clean
- New source: no `sorry`, `admit`, or explicit `axiom`
- Focused axioms: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`
- All ten authored source blobs match HEAD

The genuine remaining gates are simultaneous descent of chart maps and localization data, transition/triple-overlap gluing with base-change comparison, descent of the universal Picard natural equivalence, and an `OrbitsInAffineOpen` producer. Therefore arbitrary-field `pic0_representableBy` and the `JacobianData` headline were not added. [Challenge.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Challenge.lean:99) still contains 15 proof `sorry`s and currently sits behind an import cycle with the downstream Picard cone.

Progress was recorded and committed as `d7e5726d05`. The task remains `running`, Phase 7 remains `active`, and Phase 8 remains `pending`. The stale-skill workaround was followed with LSP loops, bounded native subagents, and a final janitor audit.

The shared index remains poisoned, currently falsely staging 12 paths with 940 deletions; disk and HEAD are intact. All commits used isolated private indexes.

The stop hook is seeing the poisoned shared index as well as live Horizon ledger files. I’m separating actual worktree deltas from false index deletions, then I’ll commit only state records attributable to this task and leave concurrent/generated workspace churn untouched.
